n-deliveries.text:
History = GET /earnings/entries?type=DELIVERY, grouped by day.

- Rows lead with time and distance; the order code is second, in secondary text. Proposed row (Needs API #148): restaurant name · drop-off area.
- No row says it was corrected (Needs API: correcting entry id / #147). A REVERSED delivery shows its status word so it never looks paid; it stays counted and its correction line offsets it (owner decision).
- 403 ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE and 200% text drawn.
- Offline: saved copy like Earnings activity; the no-copy error only on a first open.
- Empty: Go to Home. 429 drawn.
- A row links only to the Delivery board drawn for that same order (HG-4K2M-9T, HG-6R1N-3K). Rows with no board of their own are plain rows (code kept, no chevron), never a link to another order.
- Cancelled, undeliverable and returned jobs are not in this list (#148).
- Times use the 12-hour clock, for example 9:12 pm (owner decision).

n-delivery.text:
GET /riders/me/assignments/{assignment_id}: the redacted terminal view.

- Hero: restaurant name leads; order code once (not in the AppBar).
- Earnings row only when a real EarningEntry for this assignment is known, linked to that entry. Undeliverable / returned: "See Earnings activity" placeholder (Needs API #147), no amount.
- Never rendered here: unit, buzzer, special_instructions, customer_display_name, phone_alias. Drop-off street only, after pickup.
- handover_method null: no Handover card; pickup_wait_seconds null: "Wait time wasn't recorded".
- Entry points and back labels: Deliveries ("Back to Deliveries"), Entry — delivery ("Back to Delivery earnings"), Entry — tip ("Back to Tip"); focus returns to the row that opened it. A board opened from an entry or a tip is the same order as that line (HG-5P2N-8C, HG-6R1N-3K); lines with no Delivery board of their own leave "Delivery details" off. Undeliverable / returned not reachable until #147 / #148.
- Order cancelled after the rider reached the restaurant: no earnings amount (rider cancellation pay is V1, decision R-09); the earnings row only points to Earnings activity, and the note says only that the order was cancelled.
- "Problem with this delivery?" placeholder (rider delivery-history spec). Offline, 429 drawn.
- Left at the door with a photo and the rider’s statement (owner decision: only when the customer chose leave at door; drawn as HG-5P2N-8C, Friday 25 September, 5.7 km, $10.19, matching its earnings line and the Deliveries row): Handover reads "Left at the door" and "Photo and your statement recorded." The photo and statement are not on the record (Needs API).

n-whatsnew.text:
Shown once after an update, for every version since the last one seen on this device. Most often one version. A new device with no saved version shows only the latest release's notes (owner decision).

- Never during a delivery. An offer covers it: declined or expired, it comes back with focus on its title; accepted, it closes without being marked seen and waits for Home after the delivery.
- Focus: the Sheet's own title h2 (tabindex=-1), never a duplicate heading.
- "Got it" = Button secondary xl in the sticky footer; long notes scroll under it.
- Close, swipe, scrim tap or back = seen, same as Got it. App closed or an offer on top = not seen.
- Reopen from Account › What's new.
- Sample copy until release-notes.json (#97).

n-system.text:
Design system: HalalGoes (tokens 1790605103-3266, compiled from the approved tokens.json: Plus Jakarta Sans and IBM Plex Mono, dark label on the orange primary button, brand-coloured focus ring, real motion durations). Boards read semantic roles only, never raw ramp steps. No local token overrides on this canvas, with one named exception: 200% text simulation, not a token change. The 200% boards set data-hg-text-scale="200" on the root, and the source boards carry that one scaling block until the system ships a text-scale mode.

Owner decisions applied:
- Rider main actions are Button primary (orange fill, dark label 4.63:1): the rider 7:1 rule covers body text, not large bold button labels. Fill 5.09:1 on the page, 3.77:1 in a dark warning banner, 3.53:1 on surface-raised.
- Buttons that were ghost in banners and error screens are Button tertiary, so each has a visible border.
- StatCard and KeyValueList are approved for the design system (drawn from tokens here until they land). BarChart is deferred: no chart at launch.

System gaps raised:
- Button secondary: its fill (accent-600) is 1.47:1 on the dark page and 1.09:1 in a dark warning banner, with no border, so it is not used on dark rider surfaces.
- Button tertiary: its only boundary, --border-interactive (neutral-600), is 2.85:1 on surface-raised (inside a Card), under 3:1. Boards keep tertiary buttons out of Cards or use primary there.
- Badge: needs a field size (label-lg 15px, ≥32px) and a field theme (warning/info tints are raw ramp steps: warning 6.83:1, info a light chip in dark). Status drawn with the proposed StatusLabel until then; Badge with a field size stays the long-term replacement.
- SegmentedControl needs 56px; AppBar field back button and Sheet close must be 56px (both 44).
- BottomNav should be nav > links with aria-current="page", not tablist/tab.
- Price: no display-lg; announceAs has no "not counted".
- Sheet: focusable title; footer can’t be passed on the canvas.
- Icons missing from the Solar set in the system: wallet, undo, external link, hourglass, hand-money, stars. (Previous uses Icon "back" = Solar alt-arrow-left-linear.)
- AppBar title must wrap (max 2 lines) at large text: today nowrap + ellipsis truncates "Earnings activity" at 200%.
- Button label must wrap in field sizes: nowrap overflows "Show older lines" and "Fix payout account in Stripe" at 200%. Banner Fix buttons read "Fix in Stripe" meanwhile.
- Text scale: tokens.css needs a text-scale mode built like density, e.g. [data-hg-text-scale="200"]{--type-body-lg-size:34px; …}, so the 200% text boards set one attribute instead of carrying their own scaling block.
- Forced colours: the bundle’s forced-colors outline rule does not include .hg-focus-inset; add .hg-focus-inset:focus-visible{outline:2px solid CanvasText;outline-offset:-2px}.

Proposed components (composites built only from library parts and system components, labelled "Proposed component" on the boards, for owner approval): ListRow, InlineAlert, Skeleton, EmptyState / ErrorState (rider: action in the bottom third; role=alert on heading + message only), ActiveJobBar, StatusLabel (Icon md + label, 17px semibold; never brand orange or green; warning states use --feedback-warning-icon on the icon and --text-primary on the word, other states use --text-secondary-field).
